properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Alex's idea, 2026-08-14 (Opportunities), in his words: "`propagate_change` summary: separate 'same Component dump' from 'crossed an Interface.' Default `full` off is right; the summary still needs a 'sibling Capabilities on the same Component, not actually impacted' band."

DISTINCT FROM `fact:defect-propagate-change-distance-two-is-not-an-edit-list`, which measures what happened (~65 named, 113 truncated, the Interface signal buried). This holds the unmade choice about the fix.

THE OPTIONS:

(a) BAND THE SUMMARY BY EDGE KIND — group the impacted set by HOW it was reached: through a shared Component, across a PROVIDES/CONSUMES Interface, along the Requirement/Decision thread. CHEAP, changes no traversal, and it makes the useful signal findable rather than smaller. COUNTER: it renames the problem if the bands are not ranked — a hundred nodes in three labelled groups is still a hundred nodes.

(b) A NAMED "NOT ACTUALLY IMPACTED" BAND, his exact phrasing — siblings on the same Component, reported as reached-but-probably-irrelevant. HONEST, and it keeps the count visible rather than filtering it away, which matters because this project's standing preference is to report rather than judge. COUNTER: "not actually impacted" is a JUDGEMENT, and the tool would be making it. A sibling Capability on a shared Component sometimes IS impacted, and a band that says otherwise will eventually be believed on the day it is wrong.

(c) WEIGHT THE TRAVERSAL rather than band the output — DEPENDS_ON already carries `weight` and `weight_basis`, and CONSUMES carries `weight` too. A radius that decayed through weak couplings would shrink honestly. COUNTER: almost nothing in a real design sets those weights, so the decay would be uniform and the answer unchanged — this is a fix that requires a habit nobody has.

(d) DO NOTHING TO THE TOOL; FIX THE INSTRUCTION. The served loop says "update ONLY what the blast radius names", which is what makes a wide answer a defect rather than information. Softening the instruction costs nothing. COUNTER: it concedes that the radius cannot be acted on, which is most of what the tool is for.

⚠️ AND A COUNTERWEIGHT FROM THE OTHER DIRECTION, measured on reflow2's own graph this session: `propagate_change` seeded from a TemporalFact returned ZERO impacted, because ABOUT_ENTITY is not traversed. ANY CHANGE HERE MUST NOT ASSUME THE TOOL'S PROBLEM IS ONLY THAT IT IS TOO WIDE. It is too wide from one seed type and silent from another, and a narrowing fix applied blind would make the silent case worse.

NOT ESTABLISHED: the ratio — he did not report his design's total node count, so whether 178 is most of it or a tenth of it is unknown, and that number decides whether this is a threshold problem or a shape problem.
properties.name: IDEA — the blast radius reports one kind of reach. Should the summary band "crossed a published Interface" apart from "sits on the same Component", and name the siblings that are not actually impacted?
properties.rationale:
⭐ SHARPENED 2026-08-16 with a measurement and a doctrine tension, both of which narrow the question.

MEASURED ON REFLOW2'S OWN DESIGN: a real change event (`chg:artifact-intent-stops-being-injected`) returned 19 nodes at distance 1 and 1,068 impacted in total, and the FOUR `boundary_crossings` were the only part worth reading. So the ask is real at this scale, not hypothetical.

⇒ AND HALF OF IT IS ALREADY BUILT, which is worth stating plainly so nobody builds it twice: the summary already returns `boundary_crossings`, naming the crossed interfaces by id, alongside `risk_crossings`. 'Crossed an Interface' is ANSWERED today. What remains unbuilt is only the other side of the pairing — naming the siblings that are NOT impacted.

⚠️ AND THAT REMAINING HALF IS A NEGATIVE CLAIM, which is the actual open question rather than an implementation detail. A band labelled 'not actually impacted' asserts that sibling capabilities on one Component are unaffected — and sometimes they ARE, through exactly the shared state that put them on the same Component. Propagation found them because a path exists; calling that path uninteresting is a judgement about coupling the graph does not hold. This runs straight into `dec:report-dont-judge`, and into propagate_change's own refusal to say what to EDIT (`fact:defect-propagate-change-distance-two-is-not-an-edit-list`, which the guard surfaced beside this).

THREE HONEST FORMS IF THE VERDICT FORM IS REFUSED, none of which asserts anything the traversal did not establish: GROUP the ring by Component, so twenty siblings read as one component's worth; COUNT them — '17 of the 19 at distance 1 are capabilities on the same Component as the seed' is a fact, not a verdict, and is the sentence a reader actually needs; or SORT, putting crossings first and siblings last, changing only the reading order.

NOT ESTABLISHED, and it is the measurement that would decide between a verdict and a grouping: how often a same-Component sibling turns out to BE impacted. Nobody has looked.
